title: chernobyl 2013: radioactive ant bites & 115 mSv/h of pure gamma radiation
summary: A YouTuber explores the Chernobyl zone in 2013, takes a gamma spectrum of a hot reactor fuel fragment, and jokes about a radioactive ant bite. It is a hands-on amateur look at radiation in the exclusion zone.
why: Cited as an example of Chernobyl YouTuber content and of casual handling of radioactive material.

quote.text: This lady is bitten by a radioactive ant, live on camera.... near Chernobyl.
